mentions.name: Synth studio rebuild with 3-tier stands
mentions.description: This project rebuilds a music studio with multiple 3-tier stands for synths and a wall of pedals, built with basic woodworking and mounted using 3M Dual Lock.
mentions.source_excerpt: since the last thread I've managed to fully rebuild my studio setup, setting up multiple 3-tier stands for synths + the Wall-o-pedals. It came out really well!
